definitions: A stiff, sticky earth, originally used as a building material and for making pottery.
Fine-grained natural rock or soil material that combines with water to form a plastic mass and is used in pottery, bricks, and other materials.
A type of soil that is made up of very fine particles and becomes sticky when wet.
examples: The pot was made of red clay.
She moulded the clay into a small figure.
The soil in my garden is mostly clay.
